text: We do not remember days, we remember moments.
Pay attention. Be astonished. Tell about it.
The art of seeing has to be learned.
To look at a thing is very different from seeing it.
The world is full of magic things, patiently waiting.
Notice what you notice.
Write it down. It will not come this way again.
What you notice becomes your life.
Every exit is an entry somewhere else.
The eye sees only what the mind is prepared to comprehend.
Memory is the diary that we all carry about with us.
How we spend our days is how we spend our lives.
The imagination needs moodling.
You can't use up creativity. The more you use, the more you have.
What is remembered, lives.
Collect the details. They are the only things that matter.
The life of every man is a diary.
One must be an inventor to read well.
In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
Everything you can imagine is real.
Write what should not be forgotten.
Inspiration exists, but it has to find you working.
There is no such thing as a new idea. We combine old ones.
There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story.
Start writing, no matter what. The water does not flow until the faucet is turned on.
Arrange whatever pieces come your way.
Every secret of a writer's soul is written in his works.
The scariest moment is always just before you start.
You don't start out writing good stuff. You start out writing crap.
If you want to be a writer, you must do two things: read a lot and write a lot.
